_source: Grok 1.0.77 (@xai-official/grok, bin/grok-native). The hook envelope (camelCase keys with Claude's snake_case aliases session_id, tool_name, tool_input, tool_use_id; hook_event_name in Claude's PascalCase), the matcher alias AskUserQuestion -> ask_user_question, the global ~/.claude/settings.json hook source and the deny output (hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision decides, permissionDecisionReason is the message) are from the hooks documentation embedded in the installed binary, read as text. The ask_user_question argument names (questions, question, header, options with label/description, multiSelect) are from strings in the same binary; their exact schema is not legible there. Values are synthetic.
